ModMetaData.name: SkillIcons - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for SkillIcons, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Written, never run: scenario 0 (01-loading.feature) only uses Pickle's own generic step vocabulary. Scenarios 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 1 (02 through 06) screenshot the settings page, the passion icons and the Work tab modes, sliders and header modes, tagged @review - a person or a later Claude session looks at the images and judges them; nothing about their content is asserted here. They need the companion steps assembly in Tests/Pickle/Source, built against Mod/1.6/Assemblies/SkillIcons.dll. See SkillIcons/docs/TESTING.md for every scenario, and Tests/Pickle/README.md for exactly what is and is not covered.
